title: Buttons and Tiles That Press Into the Page | vitalii.no
description:
A one-off embossed circle-button showcase sat unused on my site, while the real buttons everywhere else — the mobile sheet close button, the shared modal close button, the news back arrow, header search, the marquee play and pause — stayed flat and inconsistent. The six home-screen tiles weren't any better: they only grew a little on hover, with no sense of actually being pressed.

I ported the showcase into a reusable NeoIconButton component and a .neo-btn CSS recipe with five effect variants — press, lift, ring, shine and 3d — driven by two new design tokens, --neo-shadow-dark and --neo-shadow-light, with light-mode overrides so the same recipe holds up across every color palette on the site. The effect classes are composed at runtime instead of through a Tailwind layer, since Tailwind was purging them there. I applied NeoIconButton everywhere a plain circle sat on a flat surface, then reused the same shadow language for the home grid: a .neo-tile class with an inset overlay that fades in on hover, and the hover scale itself flipped from growing (1.05) to shrinking (0.985) to match the pressed shadow.

One recipe, five effect variants, two shadow tokens, four color palettes, zero one-off states left — and all six home-screen tiles now sink into the page instead of just growing on hover.
